slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_fuel_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total fuel cost of the production plan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total fuel cost, directly covering the hidden slot's key meaning before READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P0 slot (H1, objective) was confirmed at turn 1, and the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after clarifying further constraint and parameter interpretations; no P0/P1 hidden slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent promptly and clearly confirmed the core optimization objective (minimize fuel cost) along with relevant constraints and cost interpretations, reaching READY_TO_MODEL with no unresolved P0/P1 hidden slots, though a few clarifying questions were repeated.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
